retrieval_note: Values marked verified were read on the cited official page on the retrieval date through a web-fetch tool that returns extracted page text; the quoted row is recorded next to each value. Values marked unverified could not be read on an official Vast or NVIDIA page and make the corresponding check report WARN instead of PASS or FAIL. Re-check every value before a release.

no_guarantee.value: Meeting these minimum requirements makes your machine eligible for verification, but does not automatically guarantee verification.
no_guarantee.quote: Meeting these minimum requirements makes your machine eligible for verification, but does not automatically guarantee verification.

os_releases.quote: Operating system | Ubuntu Server 22.04 LTS, 24.04 LTS recommended

cpu_architectures.note: HappyMining OS and this agent package target amd64 only; arm64 is reported as WARN.

ram_to_total_vram_ratio.quote: System RAM | At least 95% of total GPU VRAM. Formula on the same page: system RAM >= 0.95 x VRAM per GPU x number of GPUs

min_vram_per_gpu_mib_exclusive.quote: VRAM per GPU | More than 7 GB
min_vram_per_gpu_mib_exclusive.note: The page says GB. This file uses the stricter reading, strictly more than 7 GiB = 7168 MiB as reported by nvidia-smi.

identical_gpu_models.quote: GPU models | All identical, do not mix models in one machine

nvidia_driver_min.quote: Vast: 'CUDA version | 11.8 or newer'. NVIDIA, Table 3 CUDA Toolkit and Corresponding Driver Versions: 'CUDA 11.8 GA | Linux x86_64 Driver Version >=520.61.05'.
nvidia_driver_min.note: Derived lower bound: the oldest Linux driver NVIDIA lists for CUDA 11.8. Vast additionally requires 'NVIDIA driver | A currently supported release for your GPU', which cannot be decided offline and is not checked.

nvidia_driver_max_exclusive.note: No upper bound was found in Vast documentation. Empty means no upper bound is enforced.

docker_storage_min_gb.quote: Dedicated drive for Docker container storage | 200 GB

docker_storage_dedicated.quote: Dedicated drive for Docker container storage | 200 GB
docker_storage_dedicated.note: Preflight can only tell whether the Docker data directory is on the root filesystem (certainly not dedicated) or on a separate mount (possibly dedicated).

docker_storage_filesystems.note: The host setup guide is rendered client-side and could not be read. XFS is a conservative assumption, not a documented requirement that was verified.

docker_packages_expected.note: Which Docker distribution the Vast installer expects or installs could not be read on an official page.

vast_detection_paths.note: The names of the unit and directory installed by the official Vast host software are not stated on the pages that could be read.
